title: Adaptive multiscale model reduction for linear elasticity equation in perforated domains
summary: In this paper, we develop a Constraint Energy Minimizing Generalized Multiscale Finite Element Method (CEM-GMsFEM) for solving linear elasticity problems in heterogeneous perforated domains. The presence of numerous perforations introduces multiple scales into the computational domain, making direct fine-grid simulations computationally expensive. The proposed method follows the standard offline--online decomposition of CEM-GMsFEM.
